metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Jade Ceilingdrop
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Jade Ceilingdrop is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as irritated resident after falling plaster and lists clean bandage cap with one short folded tail and tiny chipped plaster slab held low as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That ceiling had one job.

records.name: Sid Bracedown
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Sid Bracedown is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as worried resident with lower lobe supported and lists short smooth splint strapped to one base lobe, one broad crutch as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Can someone move that step?

records.name: Hal Doorjam
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Hal Doorjam is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as dazed resident after a doorframe hit and lists clean side head pad and a small bent brass handle as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I thought it was the front door.

records.name: Mina Windowdraft
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Mina Windowdraft is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as startled resident with forearm dressing and lists broad wrapped forearm held to belly and a torn curtain ribbon as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: The curtain made it out.

records.name: Cobb Dustcough
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Cobb Dustcough is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as weary resident recovering after dusty debris and lists small folded clean cloth lowered beneath face and shoulder wrap as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I can still taste the hallway.

records.name: Ollie Roofwatch
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Ollie Roofwatch is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as stunned resident with neck support and lists short soft neck brace and one miniature broken roof tile in hand as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That tile used to be upstairs.
